issues.claim_or_decision: Three stragglers in the Blueprint still cite the pre-correction 8-archive-wins / 8-stale-canonical-bodies count rather than the cycle-1-corrected 7-archive-wins / 7-stale-canonical-bodies count.
issues.verification_method: Direct grep of blueprint-v1.md for '8 archive' and '8 stale' + visual inspection of Fact Disposition Table IN-004 row, Change Impact Map adrs/superseded/ line, and Alternative 2 disadvantage prose.
issues.finding: Three sites still carry the un-corrected count: (a) blueprint-v1.md:388 Fact Disposition Table IN-004 row: 'IN-004 | 8 archive/canonical collisions (IDs 0011–0017) where archive carries v2.0.0 (current); 1 collision (ID 0018) canonical-wins' — the prose 'IDs 0011-0017' attached to the 8 figure is internally contradictory (range 0011-0017 is 7 IDs); should read '8 archive/canonical collisions (IDs 0011-0018) decomposing into 7 archive-wins (0011-0017) and 1 canonical-wins (0018)'. (b) blueprint-v1.md:429 Change Impact Map: 'adrs/superseded/ (NEW directory; 8 stale canonical bodies per ADR-0055)' — should be '7 stale canonical bodies' to match ADR-0055 v1.0.1 §Architecture Impact item 1 which now correctly states '7 new files under adrs/superseded/'. (c) blueprint-v1.md:1096 Alternative 2 disadvantage prose: 'Leaves 8 archive-wins collisions silently stale in canonical' — should be 'Leaves 8 collisions (7 archive-wins + 1 canonical-wins) silently stale' or simply '7 archive-wins'. These stragglers partially undo the AA-008 remediation: the corrected count is now load-bearing in 7+ Blueprint surfaces but contradicted at these 3. A future reader cross-checking the IN-004 row against ADR-0055 v1.0.1 will see a contradiction.
issues.recommended_action: Update the three stragglers to use the corrected '7 archive-wins + 1 canonical-wins (8 total collisions)' phrasing. The Fact Disposition Table IN-004 row is the most load-bearing because that row is the binding between codebase-analysis fact and design — a reader cross-referencing it against ADR-0055 v1.0.1 will see direct contradiction.

issues.claim_or_decision: Blueprint Change Impact Map (line 428) describes the canonical adrs/ target as 'adrs/ (FR-8a/b/c/d destination; 3 new ADRs ADR-0053/54/55; ADR-0051/52 from renumber; ADR-0046–0050 from relocation; 17 from archive consolidation)'.
issues.verification_method: Cross-check '17 from archive consolidation' against the corrected arithmetic now codified in Architecture Overview ASCII (blueprint-v1.md:506-512) and Conventions Touched (blueprint-v1.md:806), which both state 9 no-collision adds (0001-0006, 0008-0010) and explicitly note 7 archive-wins (0011-0017) REPLACE existing canonical bodies (no net add) + 1 canonical-only (0007) leaves canonical untouched + 1 canonical-wins (0018) leaves canonical untouched.
issues.finding: '17 from archive consolidation' is internally inconsistent with the corrected post-cycle-1 arithmetic. The corrected Architecture Overview and Conventions Touched lines correctly say 9 no-collision adds. The '17' figure in line 428 appears to be the pre-cycle-1 conflation that AA-001 was supposed to fix (it sums 9 adds + 7 archive-wins replacements + 1 canonical-only, treating replacements as adds). This is a missed straggler from the AA-001 sweep through the Blueprint.
issues.recommended_action: Update line 428 to read 'adrs/ (FR-8a/b/c/d destination; 3 new ADRs ADR-0053/54/55; ADR-0051/52 from renumber; ADR-0046–0050 from relocation; 9 from archive consolidation no-collision adds; 7 archive-wins REPLACE existing canonical bodies and do not net-add files)'. Minor severity because the load-bearing 55-file total in Architecture Overview + Conventions Touched + Output Comparison is correct; only the Change Impact Map paraphrase is wrong.

issues.lineage: new finding (cross-section consistency in cycle-1 changes)
issues.claim_or_decision: Agreement Checklist scope row (blueprint-v1.md:159) now reads: '47 source files in adrs-migrated/ touched by Phase 2d decomposing into 7 archive-wins + 1 canonical-wins + 9 no-collision + 1 canonical-only + 30 variant deletions = 48 file-touching operations per ADR-0055 v1.0.1'.
issues.verification_method: Arithmetic check: 7 + 1 + 9 + 1 + 30 = 48; matches the stated 48 file-touching ops. However the row presents 47 source files producing 48 operations, with 7 new superseded files implicitly added; the relationship between '47 source files' and '48 file-touching operations' and '7 new superseded-archive files written' is not made explicit.
issues.finding: The '47 → 48 file-touching ops' phrasing is mathematically correct but obscures the asymmetry (each archive-wins case = 2 ops: 1 read-canonical-and-write-to-superseded + 1 git-mv-archive-to-canonical; canonical-wins = 1 git-rm-archive-final + N pre-* deletes; no-collision = 1 git-mv + N pre-* deletes; canonical-only = N pre-* deletes including v1-superseded). A reader trying to budget the Plan stage's Phase-2d task count cannot derive task atomicity from the line. The bullet immediately following (line 160) jumps to cross-reference scope without resolving the asymmetry.
issues.recommended_action: Add a one-line clarification: 'The 47 source files in adrs-migrated/ map to 48 file-touching operations because the 7 archive-wins cases each generate one additional write to adrs/superseded/<id>-pre-consolidation-canonical.md beyond the source-file consumption; thus 47 archive-source reads/deletes/moves + 7 superseded-writes − 6 (deletes that consume the source without producing a separate op) = 48.' Alternatively, defer detailed per-op accounting to the Plan-stage decomposition and note the line is a high-level scope summary. Minor severity because the accuracy is not in dispute; only the cognitive accessibility is.

issues.claim_or_decision: AC-FR-8d-1 (blueprint-v1.md:280) still describes the variant deletions as 'every `-pre-naming-convention` and `-pre-template-migration` variant shall have been deleted' — does NOT mention the v1-superseded variant.
issues.verification_method: Cross-check AC-FR-8d-1 against AC-FR-8d-2.1 (which DOES enumerate the v1-superseded variant) and against ADR-0055 v1.0.1 §Decision item 5 ('All `-pre-naming-convention`, `-pre-template-migration`, and `-v1-superseded` variants are deleted via `git rm`').
issues.finding: AC-FR-8d-1's enumeration is narrower than ADR-0055 v1.0.1 §Decision item 5 and narrower than the actual cycle-1 corrected scope. A literal reading of AC-FR-8d-1 alone would leave the v1-superseded variant out of scope; only the supplementary AC-FR-8d-2.1 closes the gap. Acceptance-criteria readers (Plan author, test author) typically read AC-FR-8d-1 as the primary specification for FR-8d scope; the v1-superseded scope sits in a numbered child AC that's easy to miss. Suggest aligning AC-FR-8d-1 phrasing with ADR-0055 v1.0.1 item 5 so the primary AC contains the complete variant-deletion enumeration.
issues.recommended_action: Update AC-FR-8d-1 to read '...every `-pre-naming-convention`, `-pre-template-migration`, and `-v1-superseded` variant shall have been deleted'. Keep AC-FR-8d-2.1 as the procedural detail (canonical-only-procedure glob extension). Minor severity because AC-FR-8d-2.1 is sufficient to make the requirement binding; this is a clarity improvement, not a correctness gap.

regression_scan_summary: Focused regression scan of v1.1.0 changes against v1.0.0 baseline + cycle-1 audit findings identifies 4 new findings, all related to incomplete propagation of cycle-1 corrections to ancillary Blueprint surfaces. (a) I-AA-R2-001 MAJOR: 3 stragglers of the AA-008 (8-archive-wins → 7) correction at lines 388, 429, 1096 — the load-bearing Fact Disposition Table row contradicts ADR-0055 v1.0.1. (b) I-AA-R2-002 MINOR: 1 straggler of the AA-001 (51 → 55) correction at Change Impact Map line 428 still cites '17 from archive consolidation' which conflates replacements with adds. (c) I-AA-R2-003 MINOR: 47 → 48 ops arithmetic in Agreement Checklist is correct but cognitively obscure. (d) I-AA-R2-004 MINOR: AC-FR-8d-1 variant-deletion enumeration narrower than ADR-0055 v1.0.1 item 5 and AC-FR-8d-2.1. No regression in the load-bearing 55-file-count, 9-no-collision-IDs, 0051/0052-renumber-targets, AC-FR-9-b.1 disambiguation procedure, AC-FR-8b-1.1 fail-safe, ADR-0055 canonical-only glob extension, ADR-0054 commitment-1/2 prose, or Bootstrapping note. The 4 findings are clustered tail-of-distribution cleanups, not architectural regressions.

The 4 new findings are all tail-of-distribution stragglers of two of the cycle-1 corrections (AA-001 file-count sweep and AA-008 archive-wins count sweep). No architectural regression. Cycle 2 should close all 4 in one composer pass; cycle-3 risk is low absent further user-scope expansion. The 4-cycle cap is not at risk.

verdict_rationale: conditional_pass: 1 MAJOR finding (I-AA-R2-001) is a regression-class issue — the cycle-1 AA-008 remediation missed 3 sites including the load-bearing Fact Disposition Table row. The MAJOR severity is appropriate because the IN-004 row is the binding between codebase-analysis fact and Blueprint design; an unresolved contradiction at that surface undermines downstream traceability. The 3 MINOR findings are quality polish that the composer should absorb in the same dispatch. Recommendation: dispatch-to-reconciler-cycle-2 for a tightly-scoped fix-up pass (4 sites total + ADR-0054 already at v1.0.1 needs no further change; ADR-0055 v1.0.1 already correct; ADR-0053 v1.0.1 already correct). Plan stage should NOT advance until I-AA-R2-001 is closed; the 3 MINORs may be deferred to a 'fix in cycle 2' batch but are recommended to land in the same pass for cleanliness.
